snippet.title: Psych2Go
snippet.description:
Welcome to Psych2Go! We are a grassroot organization with the mission of making psychology, mental health, and self-discovery accessible, relatable, and a little less lonely.

The founder initially a psychology student, found that psychology is super useful, but unfortunately wasn't accessible to the public like it is today. Through collaborative effort, him and a bunch of animators, students, made bite-sized, animated videos, to explore topics like anxiety, depression, trauma healing, relationships, emotional intelligence, self-love, communication skills, ADHD, autism, introversion, and more.

Our iconic sprout mascot represents growth, resilience, and the hope that—with the right care—we can all thrive.

Why subscribe? Because Psych2Go isn’t just a channel. It’s a global mental wellness community, where everyone can feel seen. 

Let’s grow together, one mind at a time. 🌱✨

For Collaborations & Partnerships:
📩 tu@psych2go.net
🎨 Animator & Artist Opportunities: cindy@psych2go.net

snippet.title: Kati Morton
snippet.description:
If you've ever felt like your mental health is too complicated to understand — you're not alone, and you're in the right place.

I'm Kati Morton, a licensed marriage and family therapist (LMFT), author, and speaker. I created this channel because I believe everyone deserves access to real, compassionate mental health support — not clinical jargon, not judgment. Just honest conversations about the things that matter most.

What we talk about here:
Complex Trauma & PTSD recovery
Family Dynamics and navigating difficult relationships
Eating Disorder recovery and body image
Anxiety & Depression management
Practical Tools for setting boundaries and emotional regulation

Every Monday, I show up here with clinical insights and practical tools you can actually use in your everyday life—whether you're on your own healing journey or trying to support someone you love.

snippet.title: Mel Robbins
snippet.description:
Mel Robbins is the creator and host of The Mel Robbins Podcast, one of the most successful podcasts in the world, and a #1 New York Times bestselling author. She has 40M followers and is known globally for practical tools on mindset and behavior change. The Wall Street Journal calls her a “billion-view podcaster,” and TIME says she gives millions “a reason to believe in themselves.”

Her books are published in 63 languages. The Let Them Theory is a #1 bestseller across every major list and a top-selling book of 2025 with more than 8M copies sold. She also wrote The 5 Second Rule and The High 5 Habit, and has seven #1 Audible releases.

Her company, 143 Studios, produces award-winning podcasts, books, courses, and events for partners like Starbucks, Ulta Beauty, JP Morgan Chase, LinkedIn, and Audible. She has been honored by TIME 100 Digital Voices, Forbes 50 Over 50, USA Today, Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and The Hollywood Reporter.

snippet.title: AmenClinics
snippet.description:
Better brain. Better life.
 
Amen Clinics is a world leader in brain health and mental wellness, and our channel provides information and support to anyone who wants a better brain and a better life. Our mission is to end mental illness by creating a revolution in brain health.
 
At our outpatient healthcare clinics located nationwide, we specialize in an innovative brain-body approach to mental health and peak performance.
 
Our brain-imaging work over the past 30-plus years clearly shows that we are not dealing with mental health issues, rather we are dealing with brain health issues that steal your mind.
 
The most important lesson we have learned from over 250,000 brain scans is that you are NOT stuck with the brain you have. You can change your brain and change your life. And these videos can help you do it.

snippet.title: Russell Barkley, PhD - Dedicated to ADHD Science+
snippet.description:
This channel is dedicated to disseminating the science about ADHD.  It is based on Dr. Barkley's 45 years of clinical practice, research, and teaching and his many books and scientific papers.   In 2023, he was named by Research.com as the 37th most influential researcher in the US and 65th in the world in terms of the impact of his research on psychological science as attested to by how often his research is cited by others.  He has recently retired.  In anticipation of his retirement, he has created videos of more than 30 hours of his lectures that have been posted here for laypeople and professionals alike.  
Although the initial videos posted here are in their original length as given at conferences, most videos have now been broken down into shorter segments, numbered sequentially, and organized into playlists for ease of viewing. 

PLEASE NOTE: DR. BARKLEY CANNOT GIVE ADVICE TO PERSONAL QUESTIONS FOR ETHICAL REASONS. 

His website is russellbarkley.org.  

Subscribe Now

snippet.title: MedCircle
snippet.description:
Mental health, emotional wellness and relational connection interviews with world-class experts, psychiatrists & psychologists, providing advice packed with actionable takeaways and clear explanations of the most complicated topics of today's times.

Our credentialed and vetted psychiatrists & psychologists provide valuable insight on mental health topics such as addiction, Alzheimer's & dementia, anxiety disorder, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), bipolar disorder, depression, dissociative identity disorder (DID), eating disorders, obsessive compulsive disorder (OCD), personality disorders, post traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), and more.

You will also find in-depth information on treatments like cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), acceptance & commitment therapy (ACT), electroconvulsive therapy (ECT), and ketamine infusion therapy.

snippet.title: Harley Therapy - Psychotherapy & Counselling
snippet.description:
Expert Therapists & Psychiatrists working at Harley Therapy are on a mission to transform lives through the highest quality professional support.

Based in London & online, highly qualified practitioners offers psychotherapy, counselling and psychiatric care. On this channel, we share engaging videos on anxiety, depression, ADHD assessment & support, relationships, trauma recovery, self-care and personal growth.

Our mission is to make mental health services accessible, relatable and grounded in clinical expertise. We provide practical strategies, in-depth discussions & guided exercises to help you manage stress, heal from past experiences & build resilience.

Harley Therapy is known for promoting gold standard therapy in the UK, with specialists in CBT, EMDR, psychodynamic therapy and more. We believe that everyone deserves the chance to heal, grow & thrive.

Subscribe to join a community dedicated to understanding, compassion & lasting change, because your wellbeing is a priority.

Learn how lifestyle factors, mental practices, and emotional regulation influence your brain to cultivate resilience. I explain the neuroscience behind these practices, showing you how to optimize your brain for a fulfilling life.

snippet.title: SuperNormal —Dr. Trish Leigh
snippet.description:
Dr. Trish Leigh is passionate about helping people change the way their brains are working so that they can reach their full potential. This channel is dedicated to teaching people how they can improve their brain function so they can rock out their best life possible. People with ADHD, anxiety, and many brain-based challenges feel stuck and frustrated and feel like there is no hope. I am here to tell you not only is their hope, there is neuroscience to back it! It is time to make your brain work for you and ride off into the sunset!

Disclaimer: All videos are intended for educational and informational purposes only, serving as self-help tools for personal use. They are not a replacement for professional medical, psychotherapy, or counseling advice.
